verdict.rationale: Adyen provides a Disputes API to retrieve dispute information, accept/defend disputes, and upload defense documents, plus webhooks for asynchronous status updates that an agent could poll or subscribe to — supporting agent-driven monitoring and response drafting workflows. However, there is no explicit documentation of dispute deadline fields, deadline-specific webhook events, or any AI/agent-assisted evidence-drafting feature. Missing for 10: explicit deadline-tracking fields/webhook events, documented workflow for AI-drafted evidence responses, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of agent integration with the disputes API.
